name: Cloudreve
description: A cloud drive: upload, share and preview files in the browser or over WebDAV, with per-user quotas, share links, offline downloads and thumbnails for images, video and documents. One container with its SQLite database and the stored files on its data volume.

access.note: Cloudreve starts with no account and sign-up open: the first account registered becomes the administrator. Open the address yourself right after deploying and register before anyone else can; afterwards the administrator can close registration in the dashboard's settings.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address share links are built from; it can be changed in Cloudreve's settings.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The web interface, the API and WebDAV

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database, the configuration file and every stored file

update.notes: Cloudreve migrates its database on start and does not migrate back; take a backup before moving to a newer image.
